description: Use the handle from search_products to find a public catalog product’s available variants, options, unit prices in USD cents and delivery type. Share the selected purchase_url with the shopper to open that variant on its storefront. For more variants, call again with pagination.next_offset as offset. Shipping, tax and optional customizations are determined on the site.
name: get_product_offers

list_price_cents.description: The price before a running sale, present only while one is on.

price_cents.description: Unit price in USD cents before shipping, tax and optional customizations.

purchase_url.description: Share this link to open the selected variant.

sale_ends.description: When a running sale ends (ISO 8601), present only while one is on.

next_offset.description: Request this offset with the same handle for more variants. Null on the last page.

title: Get purchasable product options
